text: Industry placement in Client Solutions. Took the DevOps and deployment side of a four-person e-commerce platform built on FastAPI, and led its migration from SQLite to Supabase. Professional client conversations and presentations throughout. Modules covering cloud, AI and cybersecurity.

IT and bookings for a family-run dog boarding business. Wrote a Google Apps Script automation that sorts incoming form responses, replacing a manual admin job. Set up a Samba file share. Bookkeeping in Sage 50. The person who gets called when something breaks.

Java plugins for a recurring competitive Minecraft event watched by thousands of spectators. Operations support during live events, changing systems while players are online. Distributed team, working through Git and GitHub.
Part-time, over ten hours a week alongside studies. Take orders in person and run the Square till and incoming Deliveroo orders during service.
Nine months on the shop floor, every week.
